notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Tiniest collapsed pill with ETA and count and a proper switch/tablist, but the opened timeline is clipped and multi-parcel tabs add clutter.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Clean two-line collapsed toast with progress bar, then a clear full timeline, carrier and number, with solid status roles and Esc support.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Segmented progress and ETA are neat and accessibility is thorough, but the opened panel is crowded with tiny demo buttons and a cut-off timeline.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Dense, polished teal-on-dark design with ETA, stops-away and tidy timeline, though it starts open and has less screen-reader support.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Tidy pill with segmented progress and ETA, but the opened panel crams tiny buttons, a dim timeline and a visibly clipped bottom.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Clean teal-on-slate toast with clear status, ETA, carrier, number and full timeline, though collapsed state lacks the tracking number.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Very compact collapsed card with ETA window and progress bar, and the open view packs carrier, number, copy, timeline with locations and actions at a readable size.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Polished multi-package pill with tabs, switch and ETA, but the open panel is crowded and the timeline is cut off at the fold.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Tight, clear timeline with ETA, carrier and tracking number and a good aria-expanded header, but it ships open by default, has no reduced-motion handling, and no real next-action beyond demo buttons.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Segmented progress bar and a rich timeline with a proper switch and good ARIA, but the open state is tall with tiny cramped buttons and a dead gap at the bottom.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Compact pill with ETA and count that opens to a multi-parcel tabbed view with copy, carrier and notify, though the opened panel clips the timeline mid-row and feels busy.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Compact collapsed toast with a progress hairline expands to a clean full six-step timeline with number, copy and alerts, with Esc, aria-expanded and reduced-motion support.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Tiny status pill with segmented progress opens to a tight timeline, tracking number, copy and carrier link, with strong aria-expanded, live region and focus support.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Polished green-accent toast with stepper, scans, copy/refresh/alerts and multi-package dots, but the open subtitle truncates the ETA and the tracking number is ellipsized.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Full seven-step timeline with ETAs, a switch for notify and good ARIA, but the opened panel is tall and the action row wraps awkwardly.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Clean collapsed toast, but the open state wastes space at the bottom, the carrier tabs are confusing, the tracking number is clipped and there is no live region.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Polished full scan timeline with NOW marker, ETA, copy, switch and good ARIA, but the open state is tall for a 'very compact' toast.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Compact header, but odd carrier tabs, a wasted gap at the bottom of the open card, no live-region announcement, and thin tracking detail.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Tight and dense with a 5-step progress bar and package switcher dots, but the subtitle truncates and the close button crowds the chevron.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Smallest pill, then a dense timeline with tracking number, copy, carrier link and updated time; amber accent holds up and ARIA and focus states are thorough.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Neat collapsed bar, but opened it has dead space at the bottom, an odd carrier-tab row, no keyboard-state announcement, and the mobile layout sits off-center.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Richest tracking with check timeline, NOW marker, locations, ETA window, copy and notify switch, but opened it is tall and the action chips wrap awkwardly.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Tight pill expands to a dense timeline with ETA, carrier, copy, carrier link and a segmented progress bar, with live region and full labeling.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Compact green-accented toast with stepper, short scan list and actions plus multi-package dots, though the subtitle truncates and the dot pager is tiny.
